project_info.theme: Clean glamour red-carpet portrait in a white sequin gown
project_info.color_palette: white, silver, gold, cream curtains and warm event light

main_subject.detail: Clearly adult woman with dark brown hair in an elegant textured ponytail, hazel expressive eyes, clean-girl makeup, champagne shimmer, soft winged eyeliner, peach blush and glossy muted-pink lips. She wears a high-neck sleeveless white gown densely embellished with reflective silver and gold sequins and crystals, with delicate diamond drop earrings and a matching tennis bracelet. Her left arm is raised near the temple and her head is tilted slightly in an elegant poised pose.
main_subject.style: photorealistic professional red-carpet DSLR portrait with dewy natural skin

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic professional red-carpet portrait of a generic clearly adult woman with hazel expressive eyes and dark brown hair in an elegant textured ponytail, sleek at the top with wispy strands framing the face. Use a clean-girl makeup aesthetic with champagne shimmer eyeshadow, soft winged eyeliner, groomed brows, luminous dewy skin, soft peach blush and glossy muted-pink lips. She wears a high-neck sleeveless white gown densely embellished with reflective silver and gold sequins and crystals in an intricate beadwork pattern, delicate diamond drop earrings and a matching diamond tennis bracelet on her left wrist. Pose her with the left arm raised and hand near the temple, head tilted slightly, elegant and poised. Use soft warm glamorous event lighting with golden backlight, a soft-focus luxury setting, cream-colored vertical pleated curtains and abstract warm golden signage. Professional DSLR photography, shallow depth of field, sharp focus, clean highlights and 8K resolution. Preserve the source gown, jewelry, pose and gala atmosphere without reproducing Ana de Armas or any public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, readable fake logo, distorted signage
